description: This is a shell script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages review lifecycle dates (start, stop, clear) for components in a project. It interacts with component metadata files, schedules review periods, and generates reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by finding metadata.yaml files in the repository excluding certain directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and list of components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and returns the path to a component's metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle date fields in the metadata.yaml file by setting them to ~.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls the script to regenerate the RAG status report.
